caption: Not every term sheet is a win. Three checks before you let an investor onto your cap table.

slides.screen: Not all money is good money
slides.say: Most founders treat every term sheet as a win. The wrong investor can cost you more than no investor at all.
Talk to founders whose companies struggled, not just the winners. That's where you learn how this investor really behaves.
Every fund has to return money by a deadline. If their clock doesn't match your path, expect pressure at the worst moment.
Diligence is a preview. If they're slow, vague, or disrespectful now, it gets worse after the wire.
Your cap table stays with you for years. Choose people you'd actually call on a bad night. Follow for more.
